clips.title: The story
paras: At the Stonefield farm in Elwynn, Gramma Stonefield quietly works to ease a family feud.

Gramma Stonefield has watched the Stonefields and the Maclures bicker for decades across the road. The oldest living member of the Stonefield clan, she sees their rivalry as senseless and harmful. When her grandson Tommy Joe Stonefield falls in love with Maybell Maclure, Gramma chooses compassion over clan loyalty. She turns to her old friend William Pestle in Goldshire and quietly plans ways for the sweethearts to meet in secret, despite the hostility between their farms.
